# GameStop Uruguay

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan technology and entertainment retailer on the Fenicio platform, unrelated to the US chain as far as its own pages say. Sells PlayStation consoles, video games and accessories, computing, audio, phones and more, with six physical stores in shopping malls.

*ES:* Comercio uruguayo de tecnología y entretenimiento sobre la plataforma Fenicio. Vende consolas PlayStation, videojuegos y accesorios, computación, audio, celulares y más, con seis locales en shoppings.

## Shopping notes

The company describes itself as Uruguayan; its pages do not state a link to GameStop Corp. Prices appear in USD and in pesos with a dollar sign. Warranty and return limits are on the shipping and returns page.
